title: The Queen
blurb: The Hive Queen has woken, and she is climbing the canyon with everything she has: broods, spit and a shriek that stops a turret dead. The last stand of the Dry Gulch.

telegram.title: The Queen Is Coming
telegram.body: HIVE QUEEN AWAKE STOP SHE CLIMBS THE CANYON ON THE SECOND NIGHT STOP SHE CALLS BROODS AND SPITS RESIN THAT GUMS TURRETS STOP HER SHRIEK STUNS STOP SHOOT THE CROWN STOP THIS IS THE LAST STAND STOP GOOD LUCK STOP

build: She's awake. Blowing her front door woke her. I could hear her humming through the rails.
Tonight her guard comes up. Tomorrow, her. Build like it's the end of the world.
Every gun I own is on your cliffs. Even the ones that explode a little.
wave: Here's her honour guard. Make them regret the trip!

build: Her crown is the soft spot. Shoot it. Respectfully, if you must, but shoot it.
All my chips on the ranchers. Don't make me look sentimental.
Whatever happens out there, it's been an honour flying over you, ranchers.
wave: Ground's moving. Something enormous is coming up the canyon. Here she comes!

boss_down: The Queen is DOWN! Clear the stragglers and the canyon is ours!
win: The Queen is dead. The Dry Gulch holds. Drinks on the Lucky Mandible!
On the house. Just this once. Don't tell anyone.
lost: She broke through. Regroup, ranchers. Queens can be beaten. We'll prove it.

journal.title: Specimen Notes, No. 8
journal.body:
The Queen is dead, and the canyon is quiet for the first time since 1889.

But her chamber was empty when she climbed. Queens do not leave a hive unattended. There must be eggs down there.

- E. Whitlow, Rail Car 9

headline_win: HIVE QUEEN SLAIN! Dry Gulch Ranchers Save the Canyon
